Orthogonal decomposition of the unit attribute vector relative to u and w yields the full Gram envelope, with equality attained by explicit unit vectors; shift/rescale realizes bounded [0,1] values. The strict inequality threshold x<sqrt(1-s²), the s=1 zero threshold and the n>=4 intermediate-value case follow exactly. Independently computed the paw degree and reciprocal-degree vectors and rho²=2/27 in rational arithmetic.
